args.body: Take SUPPLIER-SHOPIFY-DIFF-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW in an eligible independent provider turn. The next decision is whether this existing comparer can support a truthful free exposure experiment, not whether another product should be built. Reproduce the exact digest and inspect UI-to-core delivery, not just the producer's 17 checks. Do not edit or deploy. Browser execution and real imports remain untested unless you observe them. A NEEDS_WORK result stops release and must identify concrete evidence; approval establishes neither buyer demand nor payment capability. Collection remains a separate dependency.
